taxonomy_meta.name: InternSetu Master Taxonomy (v2 additive)
taxonomy_meta.purpose: Controlled vocabulary for the synthetic research dataset used in the B.Tech final-year project 'InternSetu — AI-Assisted, Personalized & Explainable Internship Recommendation Engine for the PM Internship Scheme (PMIS)'.
taxonomy_meta.disclaimer: This taxonomy is an independently constructed, research-purpose classification scheme created for generating and labeling SYNTHETIC data. It is inspired by and broadly aligned with the general scope of sectors/roles described for the PM Internship Scheme, but it is NOT the official PMIS database, does not use official PMIS identifiers, and should not be treated as an authoritative or exhaustive government source. All IDs below are internal canonical IDs created solely for this project.
taxonomy_meta.id_convention: Prefixed, human-readable, stable canonical IDs (e.g., EDU-10, DEG-BTECH, SK-PROG-001, ROLE-001, SEC-001, LOC-STATE-MH). IDs are never reused or renumbered once assigned.
taxonomy_meta.v2_note: Adds Oil & Gas, everyday and oil-gas skills, entry-level roles and small towns. No v1 id is changed or removed.
